title: Very Lightweight
text: Very Lightweight. First off there are no assembly instructions. Look at the box and work it out I guess. Which I did. For a few shelves, until I realized that it wasn't worth the effort to put together all those little connectors and pipes. Not very sturdy and nothing that I can use in my house. Was hoping since it said multi functional that it would be good for something other than shoes, but it wouldn't really  hold  a couple of boxes of wet noodles.
